answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, and publish each stake as a signed beacon record on a public ledger. A cipher-based proof ties each stake to a single hardware key, so one operator cannot mint a thousand cheap identities: each extra identity costs another full bond, and misbehavior slashes it. The umber flag on a slashed bond stays visible, so fake identities become expensive, traceable, and unprofitable at scale.
